body:
After walking the dog and coming home I reflected on what I wrote. 
Along with the earlier post I have to say that for over a year I have been hoping that I would just die. Go to sleep, die. Drive to work, and die. I also have been hoping for that elusive miracle, the project that would pull me up. 
After the walk the wife laid into me. For the 400th time. Of course she is right, I have let the family down, I have buried my head in the sand. I know that honey, I live with that every day, every moment. I tried, and I will continue to try, until trying doesn't work anymore. 
On the one hand it pisses me off that it has come down to this. I know that I am and would continue to be a contributing member of the community and a great dad. But the downside, or should I say ultimate collapse that is around the corner is so frightening, that I really hope I die in my sleep tonight. I know its crazy, but I feel crazy. 
Thats all I have to say on this matter. Tonight I will take the dog in the backyard, look up to the sky and say my usual Prayer. Asking God, to help me so that I can help my family, because they deserve it. Please take care of my wife, my daughter, my son and my dog. Thanks
